concept.subject: A big rainbow-striped hot-air balloon rising through a sky of puffy clouds, with three more balloons around it.
concept.composition: The big balloon's envelope fills the middle of the board with its basket hanging low over the bucket's path; a dark-paneled balloon rises in the lower left, a red-and-blue one is cut by the right edge at mid height and a blue-and-white one is low on the right; the clouds fill the upper half and blue sky the lower.
concept.layout: Round pegs only, 135 of them. The envelope is a curved grid: pegs along its outline and down five of its seams. Strings of single pegs droop from the upper corners over the clouds to the envelope's sides; rings of eight pegs with a peg inside sit on the lower-left and right-edge balloons, above the low right one and on three bright cloud tufts; peg lines run over the crowns of the side balloons and through the open sky, and leave the lower corners to the flippers. Level 1 introduces ramps and blockers: a rail on the lower-left balloon by the left wall and one on the right-edge balloon slope toward the middle, and the basket is a blocker with a peaked top.

background.prompt: A photo looking up at hot-air balloons in a blue sky with puffy white clouds. A large balloon with narrow rainbow stripes (red, green, yellow, coral) fills the middle: its envelope spans from about a third to two thirds of the picture width and from about an eighth to seven tenths of the height, its small basket hanging at about four fifths of the height just left of the center. A balloon with dark, purple and blue panels rises in the lower left, from the left edge to about three tenths of the width and from a little over half the height down past the bottom edge; a red, white and blue striped balloon is cut by the right edge between about two fifths and seven tenths of the height; a blue-and-white striped balloon sits low on the right, between about four fifths and nineteen twentieths of the width, from about three quarters of the height down past the bottom. Clouds cover the upper half; the lower half is clear blue sky.

picture.title: Vibrant hot air balloons soaring under a clear blue sky, perfect for travel and adventure themes.
picture.author: Steve Tarr
